What to do if your budgie escapes outside of the home.

So here's the scenario: You opened the front door, momentarily for that your beloved pet was out of his cage and on your shoulder and Whoosh! that's it, he's off! You watch him fly away up into a nearby tree and assume he's gone forever.

Well that's not the case there is a very easy and simple method to get your feathered escape artist back home.

Here's what you need:

  • The cage
  • Open window/garden
  • Speakers
  • Sound Playing Device
  • Millet or other favourite treat.
  • Access to the internet.

Method:

  1. First of all, locate your Budgie. Is he at the front or the back of the house? In a tree? In a bush? etc.
  2. Open the window nearest to him on your house and place the cage with the door open in the window, or alternatively go into the garden and take the Budgie's cage with you, leaving the door open.
  3. Place a 'trail' of the Budgies favourite treat in entrance to the cage, around the cage and inside the cage. Make sure the cage and treats can be easily spotted as Budgies have poor eyesight.
  4. Rig up the speakers to the sound playing device. Plug them in and bring them outside near the cage or inside on the window sill.
  5. On the sound playing device, go on youtube and search 'Budgies singing'. Look for one with a long time limit like this one: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ehwMH31xXmo
  6. Play it though the speakers and wait for your Budgie to come curiously down to the cage.
  7. You have to be patient and make sure you don't scare him off but once he's in quickly, quietly and calmly close the cage door.
  8. You have caught him!
  9. If he has been out longer than a few hours you should take him to the vet to get looked over to ensure he's okay, especially if there's signs of injury.
